mainEntity.name: How do I convert only one page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Click that page so it is the only one selected, or type its number in the Pages field, then convert.
150 DPI for screens and email, 300 DPI if you will print the images.

mainEntity.name: Why is my PNG so much larger than the JPG?

acceptedAnswer.text: PNG keeps every pixel exactly, which suits text but makes photos large. Use JPG or WebP for photos.

mainEntity.name: Can I get the pages as one image?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose One long image and every selected page is stacked from top to bottom.
